summary: The change adds seven direct merge-authorization, promotion-state and App-principal proof dependencies to the protected inventory, documents the scoped decision, and adds tests proving owner-landing publication plus merge refusal while reviewed callers stay ordinary. Existing protected and ordinary classifications remain consistent.

evidence: src/host/hosted-authority-protected-paths.ts adds src/repair/review-gate.ts and src/github/review-normalize.ts to HOSTED_AUTHORITY_PROTECTED_PATHS for merge authorization.

The same inventory adds src/host/actions-supervisor-state.ts, src/host/actions-supervisor-installation-state.ts and src/contracts/hosted-supervisor-installation.ts for promotion state and transition validation.
The same inventory adds src/host/hosted-app-principal-source.ts and src/host/hosted-app-principal-native.ts for App-principal issuance proofs.

docs/DECISIONS.md records the scoped #240 decision, MASTER-PLAN.md documents the authority set, and tests/host/hosted-authority-dependencies_test.ts verifies protection, owner landing, merge refusal and that reviewed callers stay ordinary.
